_meta.purpose: Smallest bounded curated layer on top of nflverse games.csv home_coach/away_coach free text. Only records that games.csv text alone CANNOT resolve belong here: name aliases/spelling drift, and interim designations (games.csv does not mark interim head coaches).
_meta.source: hand-curated from public reporting; every row is auditable against the nflverse coach string it maps
rules: aliases: maps a raw games.csv coach string (exact) to the canonical coach_name used for identity. Do NOT add an alias that only changes capitalization/whitespace -- the normalizer already handles that.
interim: [coach_id, team, season] triples (optionally with from_week) flagged interim_flag=true in coach-history and coach-game-context. team uses canonical repo abbr (wsh, lar, lac, lv).
This file must never fabricate a coach/team/season row that games.csv does not already contain.

interim.note: not interim -- full HC; listed here only to document he is NOT interim (no flag emitted)
